cards.name: Serene Mermaid of the Grand Blue

effects.printed_clause: If you control a Grand Blue monster or Umi: Special Summon this card from hand.
effects.lua_implementation: Hand ignition checks face-up Grand Blue monster or exact/treated Umi field card, open zone and summon legality.

official_references.matched_structure: Kashtira Fenrir supplies official conditional self-Special-Summon from hand structure.
official_references.official_effect_text: If you control no monsters, [b]you can[/b] Special Summon this card (from your hand). [b]You can[/b] only use each of the following effects of "Kashtira Fenrir" [b]once[/b] [b]per turn[/b]. During your [b]Main Phase[/b]: [b]You can[/b] add 1 "Kashtira" monster from your Deck to your hand. [b]When[/b] this card declares an attack, or if your opponent activates a monster effect (except during the Damage Step): [b]You can[/b] [b]target[/b] 1 face-up card your opponent controls; [b]banish[/b] it, face-down.

effects.printed_clause: During Main Phase: Fusion Summon a Grand Blue Fusion using hand/field monsters.
effects.lua_implementation: Main Phase ignition builds set-monster hand/field material and currently supports the two printed Grand Blue Fusions, sends selected material and completes Fusion procedure.

official_references.matched_structure: Polymerization is the official hand/field Fusion material procedure.
official_references.official_effect_text: Fusion Summon 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your hand or field.

effects.printed_clause: After the Fusion Summon, for the rest of the turn you may only Special Summon from Extra Deck using Grand Blue monsters as materials.
effects.lua_implementation: Four material prohibitions prevent non-Grand-Blue cards from being used as Fusion, Synchro, Xyz, or Link Material for the rest of the turn, but materialless Extra Deck procedures are not represented by those hooks. Adversarial re-review confirmed this remains non-exact. Adversarial re-review confirmed this remains non-exact.

official_references.matched_structure: Dogmatika Ecclesia, the Virtuous uses a post-resolution Extra Deck Special Summon restriction.
official_references.official_effect_text: [b]Cannot[/b] be destroyed by battle with a monster Special Summoned from the Extra Deck. [b]You can[/b] only use each of the following effects of "Dogmatika Ecclesia, the Virtuous" [b]once[/b] [b]per turn[/b]. If a monster Special Summoned from the Extra Deck is on the field: [b]You can[/b] Special Summon this card from your hand. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: [b]You can[/b] activate this effect; add 1 "Dogmatika" card from your Deck to your hand, except "Dogmatika Ecclesia, the Virtuous", [b]also[/b] you [b]cannot[/b] Special Summon from the Extra Deck for the rest of this turn.

effects.issue: Omega's prospective Extra Deck Special Summon restriction callback does not expose the material group. The Lua instead prohibits non-Grand Blue cards from being Fusion, Synchro, Xyz, or Link Material, which does not reject materialless or nonstandard Extra Deck procedures. Resolution: rewrite the restriction as four material prohibitions matching the Lua, or add a summon-limit API that receives the prospective material group and replace the approximation in c259369909.lua.

effects.printed_clause: Each effect is once per turn.

official_references.matched_structure: Ash Blossom & Joyous Spring supplies named HOPT structure.
official_references.official_effect_text:
[b]When[/b] a card or effect is activated that includes any of these effects ([b]Quick Effect[/b]): [b]You can[/b] [b]discard[/b] this card; [b]negate[/b] that effect.
● Add a card from the Deck to the hand.
● Special Summon from the Deck.
● Send a card from the Deck to the GY.
[b]You can[/b] only use this effect of "Ash Blossom & Joyous Spring" [b]once[/b] [b]per turn[/b].

cards.audit_note: Confirmed an unresolved generic materialless Extra Deck summon gap.
